scope: Output-acoustic five-point log(F1,F2) trajectories; no audio generation and no thesis manuscript edits

step1.primary_support: same 214-token three-model common strict dynamic QC intersection as frozen dynamic analysis

trajectory_geometry.position: two-dimensional mean of five log-formant points
trajectory_geometry.path_length: sum of four adjacent Euclidean log-formant lengths
trajectory_geometry.curvature: 50% vector minus midpoint of 20% and 80% vectors
trajectory_geometry.temporal_asymmetry: (20%-to-50% path length minus 50%-to-80% path length)/total path length

step1.comparison: clone-original geometry error divided by speaker-and-vowel median of up to 200 deterministic held-out original-original pairs in distinct utterances
step1.inference: speaker-equal means, equal vowel weighting for pooled vowel summary, 95% speaker bootstrap intervals; each trajectory is one token

step2.source_pairs: frozen final F5 EH_TO_AE and IH_TO_IY error/control pairs with pair_status PASS (39 and 56 before new dynamic QC)
step2.extraction: existing WAVs and frozen phone intervals; reuse the five-point Praat Burg extractor and frozen speaker ceilings, no new alignment or synthesis
step2.primary_qc: frozen pair PASS plus both roles passing strict five-point dynamic QC; failed pair excluded as a unit
sensitivity: at least four primary pairs per speaker
step2.estimand: for each matched pair, [clone-error minus original-error] minus [clone-control minus original-control], a five-point 2D log-formant function
step2.decomposition: mean trajectory translation plus mean-centered dynamic residual; canonical-axis projection of translation uses frozen speaker-specific midpoint axis; early-to-late scalar contrasts and a speaker sign-flip omnibus test describe shape
step2.inference: speaker-equal estimates with 95% speaker bootstrap; five points are one multivariate outcome, never independent replicates
step2.comparison_boundary: new strict QC may shrink the original 39/56 pair support; original midpoint DID remains the frozen confirmatory result

step3_gate: Only design or run midpoint-fixed reference generation if steps 1-2 show consequential dynamic ambiguity that existing matched and preservation data cannot answer; record decision before any generation
claims: Results are exploratory acoustic follow-up. No mechanism, listener category, perceptual correction, or active reference transfer claim without a controlled intervention. No inclusion in thesis conclusions before QC, speaker bootstrap, and sensitivity review.
